text.content: The Condition Node is binary — it only has two outputs. The exit must be built around those two outputs, not by adding a third. The pattern is a retry counter that increments on each iteration and a Condition Node that compares the counter against a maximum. While the counter is below the maximum, the false branch routes back through the Loop Node for another attempt. Once the counter reaches the maximum, the same Condition Node fires its other branch into a Direct Reply Node with a fallback message. The counter is what makes a binary Condition Node sufficient to provide a controlled exit.

text.content: Takeaway

rich_text.plain_text: Takeaway

text.content: Reading an execution trace is the most precise debugging tool available for a visual agent. It shows exactly what the agent thought, what it attempted, and what it received. The three failure modes in these traces are the most common production failures in visual agent builds. Recognising them in a trace log is the first step to preventing them in a canvas.
